verdict.rationale: Square exposes webhooks for event-driven automation and an MCP server that lets AI tools call its APIs, which are building blocks a developer could use to construct background automations, but there's no evidence of a native 'set up an automation that runs autonomously' feature (e.g., scheduled workflows, triggers-and-actions builder) — Square AI is described as a reactive in-product assistant, not an autonomous background agent. missing for 10: a documented workflow/automation engine or scheduled-trigger system, evidence of autonomous unattended execution, and independent confirmation that MCP-driven automations run without a human in the loop.
